Authors: Stien N; Riiser A; Shaw MP; Saeterbakken AH; Andersen V
Title: Effects of climbing- and resistance-training on climbing-specific performance
MainFinding: Climbing-specific resistance training improved pooled climbing-related test outcomes; evidence base was small
Limitations: Only 11 studies and 5 in meta-analysis; heterogeneous interventions
Notes: Do not infer a unique optimal protocol

Authors: Langer K; Simon C; Wiemeyer J
Title: Strength Training in Climbing: A Systematic Review
Journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
MainFinding: Positive effects were reported across strength-related outcomes with heterogeneous methods
Limitations: Only 12 studies and trends do not establish exact dose
Notes: Supports category selection more than exact dose

Authors: Langer K; Simon C; Wiemeyer J
Title: Physical performance testing in climbing—A systematic review
Journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
MainFinding: Identified 63 tests and substantial lack of standardized protocols

Authors: Pérez-Cordero J; Jerez-Mayorga D; Rodríguez-Perea Á; Soto García D
Title: Reliability of finger strength assessment methods in climbing
Journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
MainFinding: MIFS on fixed edges around 20-23 mm showed good-to-excellent reliability
Notes: Supports monitoring test selection not training dose

Authors: Quarmby A; Zhang M; Geisler M; Javorsky T; Mugele H; Cassel M; Lawley J
Title: Risk factors and injury prevention strategies for overuse injuries in adult climbers
Journal: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
MainFinding: Previous injury and some climbing exposures were associated with overuse injury; several factors conflicted
Limitations: Mostly observational evidence; prevention evidence limited

Title: How much is too much? Part 1: IOC consensus statement on load in sport and risk of injury
MainFinding: Poor load management is a risk factor and monitoring load/well-being is recommended
Limitations: Indirect evidence for climbing and no universal safe threshold

Title: Progression models in resistance training for healthy adults
Journal: Medicine and Science in Sports and Exercise
MainFinding: Provides contextual ranges for resistance training frequency loading and rest
Limitations: Old and indirect for climbing; not finger-specific

Title: Effects of Resistance Training Performed to Failure or Not to Failure on Muscle Strength Hypertrophy and Power Output
Journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
MainFinding: Failure was not consistently superior for strength hypertrophy or power outcomes
